body.text: Crypto News Bot — Daily Digest
August 20, 2026
Tether shed roughly $5.4B in market cap over 60 days as Revolut's USDT delisting deadline (Aug 31) and a new Big Four reserve audit loom.
Stablecoin News
Treasury's GENIUS Act rules add criminal teeth; Tether faces $47B reserve fix

A new Treasury NPRM defines who may legally issue or sell stablecoins, with fines up to $1M and 5 years in prison per violation. Tether is restructuring reserves and hired a Big Four auditor for its first full audit.
Circle shares fall 20% on stablecoin reward-limit fears
Circle stock dropped sharply on concerns over looming limits on stablecoin holder rewards, even as Tether faces wallet freezes and its own reserve overhaul.
Wyoming's WYST targets Aug 20 mainnet launch
The Wyoming Stable Token Commission is targeting today for the mainnet launch of WYST, the first US state-issued stablecoin.
OCC clears World Liberty Trust to issue USD1; MoonPay opens PYUSDx launchpad
The OCC gave preliminary approval (Aug 14) for World Liberty Trust Company to issue USD1 under federal oversight, while MoonPay opened a launchpad letting developers issue PYUSD-backed stablecoins.
Hacking & Security Incidents
Coldcard hardware wallet exploit tops $130M
Attackers exploited a five-year-old firmware flaw in Coinkite's Coldcard wallets, draining 1,816 BTC from 5,200 addresses — the third-largest crypto hack of 2026.
Maya Protocol loses ~$11M in liquidity-pool exploit
Six chained flaws let an attacker credit nearly 50 million tokens to a pool without proper funding on Aug 19, draining roughly $11M in value.
Crypto thefts hit $163M in August as hacker tactics shift
Monthly theft totals climbed to $163M, with attackers moving away from smart-contract bugs toward wallet and key-management exploits.
2026 hack losses pass $1.2B across 276 incidents
Year-to-date crypto theft has topped $1.2 billion, with North Korea-linked groups reportedly responsible for roughly two-thirds of stolen funds.
